additional_info.subject: ID0458086-DC/Si-D/PL-[ MP / R6 170002136] Charger not working CRM:02888000363
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon, good morning.
I checked the HMI remotely and it's not working, the service is not running.
Have you tried a reboot? If yes, and it's still the same then I assume the HMI is really not working. Since it's still Dlogic I would assume so.
You have my recommendation to replace the HMI in case you find that the 24V are applied to the PCB and tested the update. The DP doesn't seem to be the case since the HMI is not working remotely.
I will forward to your queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: Repair completed - HMI controller replaced
additional_info.body:
The screen HMI controller was replaced in the station - this solved the problem.
BR,
Szymon
